title: Placebo Website V2
summary: The public website is being rebuilt around the Placebo Era 1 identity with live server information.
changes: Replaced legacy TrinityConquer branding with Placebo Era 1.
Added live API, GameServer, player count, uptime and client patch status.
Added a dedicated Server Info page for the Era 1 ruleset.
Added live Level, PK, Nobility, Guild and Arena rankings.

title: Auto Hunt V2
summary: Auto Hunt remains as a Placebo quality-of-life feature with server-side gates and persisted VIP permissions.
changes: Auto Jump requires VIP 3 or higher.
Auto Pick Up requires VIP 4 or higher.
VIP state is persisted rather than treated as a client-only toggle.

title: Era 1 Gameplay Boundaries
summary: Post-5017 progression systems are being removed or blocked so the adapted 5695 client follows the Placebo Era 1 ruleset.
changes: Mount gameplay, riding equipment and mount skills are blocked.
Clan gameplay and later Frozen Grotto content are disabled.
Chi, Sub-Class, Talismans and Martial Arsenal remain outside the ruleset.
Classic progression remains capped at level 130.
